question: Which sport is played by the Indian sportsperson Bhakti Sharma?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swimming**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Bhakti Sharma** is an Indian open water swimmer who has set various records in open water swimming.
 
• She has swum in all five oceans of the world, as well as eight other seas and channels, making her the youngest in the world to do so.
 
• Bhakti Sharma is known for breaking the world record by swimming 1.4 miles in 52 minutes in the freezing waters of Antarctica in January 2015.
 
• She was awarded the prestigious Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award in 2010 and has also received several other accolades for her achievements in swimming.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Open Water Swimming:**

 
 
• Open water swimming is a swimming discipline which takes place in outdoor bodies of water such as open oceans, lakes, and rivers, as opposed to swimming in pools.
 
• It is part of the Olympic Games and other international competitions, with distances typically ranging from 5 km to 25 km.
 
• Open water swimming poses unique challenges such as varying water temperatures, currents, and natural obstacles.
 
 
 
• **Antarctica Swimming:**
 
 
• Swimming in Antarctica is extremely challenging due to the frigid temperatures, which can be as low as -2°C (28°F).
 
• It requires exceptional physical and mental endurance, as well as specialized training to acclimate to the harsh conditions.
 
• Swimmers undertaking such feats often wear specially designed swimsuits or wetsuits to protect against hypothermia.
 
 
 
• **Achievements and Awards:**
 
 
• The Tenzing Norgay National Adventure Award, named after the famous mountaineer, is one of the highest adventure sports honors in India.
 
• Bhakti Sharma has been recognized for her contributions to swimming and her inspirational achievements in pushing the boundaries of human endurance.
